title: Tiger cub in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#f2a03d'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#fbe2b8'/>

  <path d='M28 62 q6 4 4 10' stroke='#5a2d0c' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='66' cy='90' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#e88c2a'/>

  <path d='M58 16 l2 7' stroke='#5a2d0c' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 36 q5 0 5 5' stroke='#5a2d0c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 36 q-5 0 -5 5' stroke='#5a2d0c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#fbe2b8'/>

  <ellipse cx='42' cy='35' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#3a1d08'/>

  <circle cx='59' cy='33.5' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <path d='M46 43 h8 l-4 4 z' fill='#c96a8a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 47 q0 3 -4 3 M50 47 q0 3 4 3' stroke='#a04f1e' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M38 44 l-8 -2 M38 47 l-8 2 M62 44 l8 -2 M62 47 l8 2' stroke='#a04f1e' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
